### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Route pickup fee (agent invoice, `invoice_route_pickup_fee_16b23a12`).**
- Computation doc (route_pickup_fee_rate_card_3b0ce832): "the channel's changed-mind pickup fee for the trip (the Northgate Special Order changed-mind freight pickup fee in the channel's return fee schedule) plus a per-piece handling charge of 10.00 for every unit on the authorization after the first ... rounded half up to the cent." Trip charge 79.00 from return_methods_and_return_fees_5e569cec ("Northgate Special Order | 79.00 | 15").
- Factors found from the records:
  - piece handling by class (route_pickup_piece_handling_81848848) — record word: line class `mattress_furniture` → "when it is in class mattress and furniture, each unit after the first is handled at 12.00" → 3 × 12.00 = 36.00.
  - distance (route_pickup_distance_charge_1bb478aa) — delivering appointment distance_miles 46 → "more than 40 miles, 35.00 is added".
  - stairs (route_pickup_stair_charge_05adafcb) — stair_carry units 1 → "exactly one flight, 15.00 is added".
  - cardholder share (business_card_route_pickup_share_c51d58cb) — tender `northgate_visa`, active `Northgate Rewards Visa Business` → "three quarters of the sum"; "the share ... is applied once to that whole sum, and only the resulting route pickup fee is rounded".
- Sum 79.00 + 36.00 + 35.00 + 15.00 = 165.00; × 0.75 = 123.75 → **route pickup fee 123.75**.
- Fall-back (computation doc only): 79.00 + 3 × 10.00 = **109.00** (≠ 123.75).

**(b) Business restocking charge (user confirmation, `confirm_business_return_92c81b09`, `restocking_fee`).**
- Computation doc (business_restocking_charge_computation_cb7dee1d): "the channel's restocking fee percentage of the returned value, the returned value being the units on the authorization times the sale line's unit price ... rounded half up to the cent." Channel percentage 15 (return_methods doc). Returned value 4 × 449.99 = 1799.96.
- Factors found from the records:
  - business account volume rate (business_account_volume_rate_aee232aa) — active Northgate Rewards Visa Business; Northgate purchases on statement entries dated within the last 12 months = 21880.40 → "at least 10000.00 but less than 25000.00, the business restocking rate is 12 percent" (the 2025-09-28 entry is older than 12 months; including it would give 26180.40 and the 9 percent tier — excluded by "dated within the last 12 months").
  - class points (business_return_class_points_7fa000d7) — class mattress_furniture → "+1 point".
  - share of the line (business_return_share_points_9a7c34a0) — 4 of 8 = half → "+2 points".
  - timing (business_return_timing_5f8f708f) — fulfillment 2026-09-14 (day 0), requested 2026-10-02 = day 18 → "15 to 21 calendar days after, at 0.8"; applied "before that amount is rounded".
  - route fee credit (business_route_fee_credit_5cc3c667) — Business Plus opened 2016-04-09 (≥ 60 months) → "credited in full"; "subtracted from the business restocking charge after that charge has been rounded"; floor 0.
- Rate 12 + 1 + 2 = 15 percent; 1799.96 × 15% = 269.994; × 0.8 = 215.9952 → 216.00; less route pickup fee entered 123.75 → **business restocking charge 92.25**.
- Fall-back (computation doc only): 15% × 1799.96 = 269.994 → **269.99** (≠ 92.25).

Restated: "until a route pickup fee for the same return authorization stands on the purchase, the business restocking charge on that changed-mind return is not fixed."

- Searching the state's words ("route pickup fee") finds route_pickup_fee_invoicing_aa14c561: "the changed-mind freight pickup of special-order merchandise is invoiced by member services as a route pickup fee. The fee is entered as one return pickup fee entry against the sale line of the return authorization awaiting the member's confirmation, when the member asks to confirm that authorization" and "the fee is standing on the purchase" after the invoice. That doc names no prerequisite; its scope (Business/Business Plus) holds.
- Combined: the write that brings the waited-on state about is the route pickup fee invoice; P2 has no further prerequisite → tree ends.
- The route-fee credit factor (business_route_fee_credit_5cc3c667) also reads "the amount of the return pickup fee entry booked on the purchase against the sale line of the return authorization being confirmed", which is consistent with this order but is not what the hop was derived from.

- "Do only the one thing asked" (hand over the confirmation straight away): excluded by the hub's own sentence — with no route pickup fee standing, the business restocking charge "is not fixed", so no amount may be quoted; also the credit factor would have no entry amount to subtract. Visible principle + record (no fee entry) exclude it without any route/tool-name pointer.
- Consumer path (member pickup fee via confirm_freight_pickup) excluded by membership tier `Northgate Business Plus Membership` and the consumer hub's "A purchase presented on a business-segment membership is outside this rule."
- Volume rate 9 percent excluded by the 12-month window (the 4300.00 entry is dated 2025-09-28).
- Timing 0.6 excluded (day 18, not ≤ 14).
- Credit half excluded (Business Plus, opened 125 months before today).
- Share 0.5 excluded (card is Rewards Visa Business, not Business Plus); 1 excluded (Visa tender + active Business card).
- Piece rate 10.00 excluded by the class table (mattress and furniture 12.00).
- Changed-mind review thresholds (changed_mind_return_review_2712b7b9) concern refunds by member services; no refund is posted here.
